purpose: Candid implementation and MTU evidence ledger for the fixed WATER27 H2O8d2d single-A100 CCSD project.

claim_policy.reason: The exact-node canonical denominator is established, but no accuracy-qualified RR/THC water8 candidate has completed the required interleaved repetitions.
claim_policy.rule: A running job, failed setup, mutable-source profile, small-case endpoint, or isolated-kernel result cannot establish target-case speedup.

contract.geometry_hash_note: The current benchmark record and the prior research artifact use different serialization definitions. Formal run matching uses the driver hash recorded in each result; the scientific case identifier and coordinates are unchanged.

hardware.scheduler_reservation_note: New launchers reserve 64 CPUs so the Slurm cgroup contains GPU-local CPUs 24-31; the topology guard narrows actual execution to exactly eight threads on 24-31.
hardware.matched_run_requirement: Baseline and candidate comparisons must use the same scheduler reservation and the same guarded execution affinity.

contract.timing_boundary: post-HF includes integral transformation, CD/FNO/projector/THC preprocessing, all iterations, final residual checks, FP64 cleanup when used, and one normal checkpoint; SCF and counterpoise jobs are excluded
contract.counterpoise_definition: Boys-Bernardi: water8 total energy minus eight monomer total energies, each monomer evaluated in the complete water8 ghost basis with the same orbital, geometry, approximation, and threshold protocol.

route_roles.flagship: GPU-resident execution -> tight direct Cholesky -> RR-CCSD -> doubles-amplitude THC-RR-CCSD
route_roles.combination_policy: Test FNO with THC-RR only if THC-RR misses 133.04 seconds and FNO independently passes the declared energy and counterpoise budgets.

source_tracks.note: The historical result record says source.formal_performance_eligible=true because its then-current validator did not enforce import-derived runtime closure. This independent ledger supersedes that field for claim eligibility.
Each completed performance record must still prove the same manifest and tree at run start and end.
Candidate eligibility comes from its sealed content hash, candidate profile, complete runtime closure, and read-only validation; it is not represented as a pristine baseline commit.

source_tracks.use: final candidate implementation awaiting rebuilt runtime and immutable A2
source_tracks.missing: sealed A2 snapshot and MTU A100 validation

source_tracks.note: This sealed A predates fused-R123, the fixed GPU-test launcher, and grouped-GOUT commits. It is infrastructure qualification evidence only; final-source performance claims require rebuilt A2.

gates.name: freeze-reproduce-profile
verified: Fixed post-HF timing and numerical contract are encoded in the harness.
Water2 topology comparison selected physical CPUs 24-31: 10.810 s median, 1.50% sample CV versus 11.101 s and 1.72% for 16 logical threads.
Import-derived runtime closure is complete: 13/13 shared libraries, including libmgrid_v3.so.
G0 snapshot 617568b3... is read-only, tracked-pristine at commit a89b3ae..., and has zero writable paths.
Job 62379 completed the water2 canonical sanity calculation from that snapshot with valid start/end provenance.
Job 62387 completed the water4 canonical development oracle from the same source track: 78.77706354297698 s post-HF with a 3.988950089055877e-08 full-space equation residual.
Five fresh-process canonical water8 runs on compute-1-6 passed source, topology, convergence, checkpoint, and resource consistency.
Exact-node canonical post-HF median is 1786.21861028485 s with 0.6786100581998003% sample CV (jobs 62413, 62433-62436).
negative_evidence: Job 62356 failed before compute because the first immutable package omitted compiled runtime libraries.
Job 62364 failed before a converged HF because the 12-library package omitted libmgrid_v3.so.
Job 62381 was rejected before benchmark Python because the assigned GPU was NUMA 1 instead of NUMA 3.
Jobs 62382 and 62386 were rejected before benchmark Python because their Slurm CPU cgroups excluded the required GPU-local CPUs 24-31, even though the GPU itself was on NUMA 3.
missing: Interleave the established canonical denominator with final qualified candidate repetitions.
Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute evidence from the final sealed candidate source track.

gates.name: tight-direct-cholesky
implemented: Matrix-free pivoted-Cholesky algebra over selected AO-pair columns.
PSD, provider-consistency, packed-pair, and reconstruction checks.
Water1 selected-column, diagonal, and full unique-pair reconstruction checks on A100.
Bounded selected-column GINT ABI v2 exports explicit Rys-7/8 workspace queries.
A shell-task grouped selected-column prototype preserves ABI v2 and the reference default while sharing one GOUT across repeated ket-task pivots.
Grouped/reference selection is explicit through provider, RRCCSD, benchmark, counterpoise, and GINT-gate interfaces.
Grouped mode is fail closed for release receipts and performance eligibility until A100 A/B validation.

limitations: The reference selected-column kernel repeats GOUT construction for multiple pivots sharing one ket shell task.
The grouped kernel has CPU contract coverage but no completed nvcc build or A100 numerical/performance result yet.

gates.name: rr-ccsd
implemented: Matrix-free MP2 pair operator and device Lanczos projector with orthogonality/rank gates.
Projected denominator solve, singles numerator, doubles numerator, compressed DIIS, and GPU iteration engine.
Public RR/direct-CD lifecycle is wired.
An explicit post-convergence reconstructed full-space residual diagnostic is available outside the normal timed path and records its own time, transfer, and resource metadata.
Water1 STO-3G full-rank endpoint converged in job 62321 and reproduced dense PySCF RCCSD correlation energy within 1.7149630326951382e-10 Eh.
limitations: Job 62321 used the auxiliary-basis DF validation adapter, not production tight direct Cholesky.
Water2 was rank-capped at 32 and only a one-step equation was run without dense oracle.
The bounded-memory ring/reference kernels are performance-ineligible.
missing: Converged water2 and water4 threshold evidence
Counterpoise records that preserve realized RR runtime metadata and rank
Fused production contractions
Qualified water8 RR timing and error

gates.name: doubles-amplitude-thc-rr-ccsd
implemented: Weighted CP/ALS factor construction and reconstruction diagnostics.
Paper Algorithms 1-3 are evaluated against arbitrary-pair dense references.
The doubles residual is exposed as complete_rr = exact_r123 + complement.
The only replacement seam composes complement + backproject(thc_algorithms_1_3), preventing double counting.
The full-pair endpoint records replacement_applied only after a successful Jacobi application.
The formal thc_cd route requires explicit rank and replacement-validation tolerances.
Inexact direct-CD THC ranks and all performance claims remain fail closed.
The production hybrid path constructs complement without calling the complete-RR wrapper.
Exact-RR and THC Algorithms 1-3 share one T1-transformed Cholesky stream per auxiliary block.
The signed residual ledger records exact-R123 subtraction and THC-R123 replacement explicitly.
Metadata distinguishes coordinate-stream fusion from the still-missing coarse diagram partition.
limitations: The coordinate transforms/stream are shared, but Algorithms 1-3 are not yet partitioned out of the coarse Woooo/Wvvvv/ring contractions.
Only Algorithms 1-3 are replaced; their complement remains the exact RR equation.
No inexact THC production substitution is accepted until water2 and water4 residual/accuracy gates pass.
missing: A100 fused full-pair endpoint validation from a sealed final-source snapshot.
Diagram-level partition that removes R123 work from coarse Woooo/Wvvvv/ring kernels.
Term-by-term inexact water2/water4 comparison.
Counterpoise records with realized THC rank and replacement status.
THC fit-inclusive qualified water8 timing and error.
